sourceDiscoveryRules: Use official county, appraisal district, assessor, GIS, open data, or municipal sources first.
Do not treat permit contractor/applicant fields as parcel owner fields.
Preserve source dataset identifiers, pull dates, join keys, and count checks.
Mark owner/appraisal sources as source-needed until an official bulk export, API, or legally usable source is verified.
Do not load huge shapefiles directly in the browser; build viewport chunks, search shards, and vector tiles.
Keep the app disabled for a county until QA reports have exact counts and no blocking join-key uncertainty.

activeExamples.whyItMatters: This is the model county. It has parcel geometry, DCAD owner/appraisal tables, permit joins, zoning/floodplain plumbing, development signals, viewport chunks, search shards, and locked QA counts.
This proves the adapter can move beyond Texas. Parcel geometry, LRSN, PARCELID, zoning, floodplain, and PVA owner/appraisal hooks are documented.
This is the next North Texas adapter candidate after DCAD.
